citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event) 
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  WITH substring(e.timestamp_utc, 0, 13) + ':00:00Z' AS hour, count(*) AS n
  RETURN hour, n
  UNION ALL
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour) 
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.hour_utc AS hour, ch.event_count AS n
}
WITH hour, sum(n) AS total_events
RETURN hour, total_events
ORDER BY total_events DESC LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN ch.camera_location AS location, sum(ch.event_count) AS crowd_samples, avg(ch.avg_hc) AS avg_head_count, max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_head_count
  ORDER BY crowd_samples DESC LIMIT 1
}
RETURN location, crowd_samples, avg_head_count, peak_head_count
